Solutions 2 and 3 are unconvincing. Solution 2 assumes the result is about trivalent graphs without justification, and Solution 3 misidentifies the cohomology structure of $M_{g,m}$. Solution 1 gives 6, which matches my recollection of the Kontsevich–Takeda–Vlassopoulos work on pre-Calabi–Yau structures and ribbon quivers. I could not verify that bound against the source here, so my confidence is moderate.
